outcome: NICU admissions (due to prematurity, sepsis, low birth weight, jaundice)
cohort: The study included 60 patients who conceived through intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).
finding: The major outcomes of ICSI pregnancies were cesarean delivery (56.7%), followed by miscarriages (28.3%) and multiple pregnancy (17%).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was the major outcome, experienced by 56.7% of women.
birth_weight: 80% of the babies weighed between 2.5 and 4 kg.
